title: "Firmware version unknown! Please report" - What you should do when you see this
symptom: A Dexcom user sees the message 'Firmware version unknown! Please report' on the system status page if their firmware is new and unknown. Even after reporting, xDrip still shows the same message in red, appearing to require an action from the user.
fix: The thread suggests that the user should report the firmware and upgrade to the latest nightly when available, and provides a wiki link with instructions.
evidence_quote: Just change the message to "Please report and upgrade to latest nightly when available"
